items.title: Fallout Star Walton Goggins Explains The Ghoul ( Plus, White Lotus Season 3) Interview
items.description: The wonderful Walton Goggins plays The Ghoul in Prime Video's new Fallout series, out April 12. He told MovieWeb's Greg Archer what it was like to take on The Ghoul, getting bit by a brown recluse spider five times, and how excited he ease for Mike White's third season of The White Lotus.
